## Objective
- Continue developing the playable 2D RPG, now titled **Agrippina, The Testament of Death** (short: Agrippina), using the existing game as a foundation.
- Transform the current world and its design into a grounded, bleak dark-fantasy setting.

## Requirements
- Mature, mysterious, morally complex tone; muted pixel art, deep shadows, medieval ruins, and restrained crimson, pale-gold, or sickly-green accents.
- Death is irreversible for everyone except the protagonist, who returns with memories when the world resets to a fixed point.
- The protagonist is not a chosen hero; inhabitants have independent motivations, and the world is indifferent to them.
- Build a complete, playable game without clarifying questions; make reasonable assumptions.

## Decisions
- The opening location is **Hollow Ash Parish** in the **Ashen March**.
- The starter quest is **The Bell’s Last Toll**: recover three iron death-tolls and bring them to the ruined chapel altar.
- The gravedigger **Edda** replaces the meadow companion; the old cottage becomes a ruined chapel.
- Keep the existing movement controls, local-save approach, and editable four-step roadmap.

## Objective
- Continue developing **Agrippina, The Testament of Death**, a playable 2D RPG with a bleak, morally complex dark-fantasy setting.
- Build beyond the opening quest while preserving movement, local saves, and the editable four-step roadmap.

## Requirements
- Keep the muted pixel-art style, deep shadows, medieval ruins, and restrained accent colors.
- Death is irreversible for everyone except the protagonist, who returns with memories when the world resets to a fixed point.
- The protagonist is not a chosen hero; inhabitants have independent motivations and the world is indifferent to them.
- Build a complete playable game without clarifying questions; make reasonable assumptions.

## Decisions
- Opening location: Hollow Ash Parish in the Ashen March.
- Starter quest: **The Bell’s Last Toll**—recover three iron death-tolls and bring them to the ruined chapel altar.
- Gravedigger Edda replaces the meadow companion; the old cottage became a ruined chapel.
- The altar artwork was shifted by `(240, -40)` and its collision/interaction coordinates were adjusted.
- After the bell answers, the new continuation leads into an underground crypt with a pursuing wraith and a recoverable memory.

- Rebranded the game as **Agrippina, The Testament of Death** and updated opening text, roadmap defaults, quest language, and local-save keys (`agrippina-save-v1`, `agrippina-roadmap-v1`).
- Reworked the opening quest to death-tolls, Edda, chapel, and altar; removed meadow-era labels and identifiers.
- Fixed altar collision and interaction coordinates; previously verified collecting three death-tolls, completing the altar interaction, and save persistence.
- Added an underground crypt scene, a “first burial” memory objective, a chasing wraith, and a death reset that restarts the parish quest while retaining memories and death count.
- Added scene-aware quest panel text and location/time labels for the crypt.
- JavaScript syntax check and `git diff --check` passed after the crypt additions.

- Validate the new crypt continuation in-browser, including stair access, memory collection, wraith death/reset, and save/reload behavior.
- Continue expanding gameplay beyond the opening quest.

1. Test the new crypt gameplay and fix any movement, collision, objective, or save-state issues.
2. Run browser console and visual checks; verify the parish and crypt flows survive reloads.
3. Continue building the next roadmap chapter after the crypt.

- `index.html`: Single-file game implementation, styling, world rendering, controls, quest state, local saves, and editable roadmap.

- Changes are uncommitted; `git status --short` reported `.gitignore`, `Agents.md`, `capture.sh`, `index.html`, `start.sh`, and `startup.sh` as untracked.
- The browser previously had an opening-quest save with three tolls collected and `bellAnswered: true`; crypt changes have not yet been browser-tested.

## Objective
- Continue developing **Agrippina, The Testament of Death**, a playable 2D RPG with a bleak, morally complex dark-fantasy setting.
- Build beyond the opening quest while preserving movement, local saves, and the editable four-step roadmap.

## Requirements
- Keep the muted pixel-art style, deep shadows, medieval ruins, and restrained accent colors.
- Death is irreversible for everyone except the protagonist, who returns with memories when the world resets to a fixed point.
- The protagonist is not a chosen hero; inhabitants have independent motivations and the world is indifferent to them.
- Build a complete playable game without clarifying questions; make reasonable assumptions.

## Decisions
- Opening location: Hollow Ash Parish in the Ashen March.
- Starter quest: **The Bell’s Last Toll**—recover three iron death-tolls and bring them to the ruined chapel altar.
- Gravedigger Edda replaces the meadow companion; the old cottage became a ruined chapel.
- Altar artwork was shifted by `(240, -40)` and its collision/interaction coordinates were adjusted.
- After the bell answers, the continuation leads into an underground crypt with a pursuing wraith and a recoverable memory.

## Work State
### Completed
- Rebranded the game as **Agrippina, The Testament of Death** and updated opening text, roadmap defaults, quest language, and local-save keys (`agrippina-save-v1`, `agrippina-roadmap-v1`).
- Reworked the opening quest to death-tolls, Edda, chapel, and altar; removed meadow-era labels and identifiers.
- Fixed altar collision and interaction coordinates; previously verified collecting three death-tolls, completing the altar interaction, and save persistence.
- Added the crypt scene, first-burial memory objective, pursuing wraith, and death reset that restarts the parish quest while retaining memories and death count.
- Added scene-aware quest panel text and location/time labels for the crypt.
- Fixed altar interaction so the crypt can be reopened after recovering the memory.
- Verified crypt loading, memory recovery, and stair return to the parish with memory retained.
- JavaScript syntax check and `git diff --check` pass; browser console showed zero errors/warnings.

### Active
- Validate the wraith’s death-and-reset flow in-browser.
- Continue expanding gameplay beyond the opening quest.

### Blocked
- (none)

## Next Move
1. Test the wraith death/reset path and confirm parish quest reset, retained memory/death count, and save/reload behavior.
2. Continue building the next roadmap chapter after the crypt.

## Relevant Files
- `index.html`: Single-file game implementation, styling, world rendering, controls, quest state, local saves, and editable roadmap.

## Important Context
- Changes are uncommitted; `git status --short` lists `.gitignore`, `Agents.md`, `capture.sh`, `index.html`, `start.sh`, and `startup.sh` as untracked.
- Browser testing used `http://localhost:3002`; a local server was already occupying port 3002.
- A clean browser test of the wraith’s death-and-reset flow was not completed.

"Together, we may yet change the fate of this world."
